speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) requires owners of buildings with higher safety risks, such as publicly accessible buildings with higher occupancy, to appoint a professional engineer to audit a building’s fire safety measures annually.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The Energy Market Authority (EMA) requires building owners to appoint a licensed electrical worker to conduct regular inspections to ensure that electrical installations are fit for operation.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The Public Utilities Board (PUB) requires building owners to engage a licensed plumber to inspect their potable water tanks annually to ensure that the water is fit and safe for use.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The National Environment Agency (NEA) requires building owners to dispose of their refuse properly, such as by maintaining refuse chutes and also to prohibit any person from creating conditions favourable to the propagation of vectors.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: I know the Member is concerned about building maintenance.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: But if buildings are not properly maintained, the respective agencies can direct building owners or management corporations (MCs) to make rectifications where necessary.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: For example, BCA can issue a Notice to Maintain to building owners or MCs to compel them to repair defects.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Failure to comply with regulatory requirements or directions is an offence under the respective Acts and Regulations, and the relevant public agencies can take enforcement actions against the building owners, MCs or building occupants accordingly.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Penalties for non-compliance include fines or imprisonment or both.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Public agencies maintain the infrastructure on public land under their respective purviews across Singapore, including public infrastructure within private residential estates.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Members of the public can provide feedback on maintenance issues directly to the agencies or via the Municipal Services Office, using the OneService app.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: There are quite a number of condominiums in my constituency.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: The frequent feedback that I got from the Managing Council is that they are all laymen, not familiar, so they appoint the managing agent (MA).

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: So, they are asking whether the Ministry of National Development (MND) will rank the MAs because many of them also run into problems with their MAs.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Will MND rank the MAs, that means, categorise them?

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Currently, the MC can appoint an MA for up to a term of three years.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: So, the MAs' performance can be reviewed by the residents themselves and they can change the MA if they do not perform.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: If the MAs are not performing, the residents can certainly take action.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Because, ultimately, as the Member knows as well, you can rank an MA by company, but it is still down to the persons that they appoint, the persons that they hire to run every condo.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: You can rank an agency but it really depends on the team that they put in place.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: It is just that the details are important, that we pick the right MA and appoint them.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: But again, it is down to the person that they appoint in the condo.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: So, it is down to the MCs to decide.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: Three years is a long time if your MA is not performing and then the MC will have to fight with the MA almost every other day.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: So, what MC is asking is that if MND can come up with certain qualifications, so that they can rank the MA accordingly, then at least it is a table of approved or accredited MAs for them to choose.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: The feedback is that a lot of the MCs told me that they are very disappointed with a lot of the MAs in the market.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: It is just, if I may put it in their language, in Hokkien "tan jiak, tan jiak", but then who suffers?

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Do refer to the scheme and maybe the MCs can work closer with the organisations – SISV as well as APFM who manage the scheme – to see how we can improve the accreditation scheme.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: But to get into ranking, the tricky part is, as I said, that it depends on the performance of the MA on the ground and, ultimately, it is down to procurement.
